puzzle.hint: A verse about Allah's constant activity and that all creatures depend on Him.
puzzle.arabic: يَسْـَٔلُهُۥ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ هُوَ فِى شَأْنٍۢ
puzzle.verseEn: Whoever is within the heavens and earth asks Him; every day He is in [i.e., bringing about] a matter.
